_comment: Routing-assertion config (R4-D32 #3). Copy to .claude/routing.json and fill in YOUR project's high-risk surface + DB-safety skill. The harness ships only this .example so the harness itself stays inert. A change matching the patterns below must carry a '<requiredTrailer>: <skill>' commit trailer (added after the DB-safety skill reviews it) or the merge-time check (scripts/check-routing.sh, run in CI via ci-verify.sh) blocks. The run-time twin (docs/routing-gate.md) stops the edit live. Patterns are extended-regex (grep -E); content patterns are matched case-insensitively against the diff.
safetySkill: the project's database-safety skill (e.g. /supabase) — declared here, never hardcoded in the harness
